privileged_info_for_vlm: The Revenue Recognition Rule must be named '12 Month Subscription'. The 'Time Based' field must be enabled (internally 'Y'). The Recognition Frequency must be set to 'Month' (internally 'M'). The description must contain 'Ratable recognition'. The task is performed in the iDempiere ERP system for the GardenWorld client.
